readings._audit: 2026-10-05 convention audit (z = -m, side by where the bodyside shows, lamp0 = train's left): side far, lamps, screen1 near/far correct; no modelFace points. No change.

notes: nose to the right: the train's RIGHT side is visible, side far. lamp0 = train's-left cluster (image right). Door openings are recessed: the rear reveal shows, so rear edges are the reveal's outer edge. Cab door and door bottoms on the rear side are lost in shadow. No axles: the bogie frames hide the axleboxes. Doors: the opening runs from just under the cantrail line (a navy head block over the leaves) to the step; door 1's leaves are orange above 2.83 m, door 2's blue to ~3.1 m, so door-top corners are only used on door 1 (the paint line) and the opening's edges are taken where they meet the cantrail line (model points *-cl).
